title: Adversarial verification
summary: A separate invocation tries to falsify a candidate.
useWhen: Claims need reproduction, counterexamples or source checks.
A quality gate warrants an independent check.
avoidWhen: The reviewer cannot access the relevant artifacts or evidence.
A rhetorical disagreement is treated as validation.
contract: Report passed, failed or inconclusive with evidence.
Same-model invocations can share failure modes.
example: Try to reproduce each reported authentication bypass before accepting it.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  W[Candidate] --> V[Independent verifier]
  V --> P[Passed]
  V --> F[Failed / inconclusive]
